verdict.rationale: Cline's CLI example shows it can accept an image reference (@./screenshot.png) to address a layout issue, implying some multimodal/image input capability, and general docs confirm it can build features from natural conversation and modify files/commands. However there is no evidence of a dedicated 'sketch/image/PDF-to-app' workflow, no PDF input support, and no documented end-to-end example of generating a full working app from a design file. missing for 10: PDF input support, a documented sketch-to-app or design-to-code workflow, evidence of generating a complete app (not just a layout fix) from an image.
